as_told.title: P3 assets given drug cocktails to interface with craft

plain: An online commentator known as UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025 that there is testimony about psychic people, which he calls psionic assets, who are used to call in unknown craft. He says, citing men named Jake Barber and Michael, that these people are treated badly and given drug cocktails to perform well, which can lead to danger or death. Michels tells it too, saying that in his summer 2024 interview, Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle, described these people as P3 assets who were treated like trash and drugged so they could connect with the craft. If true, it would mean a hidden programme is using and harming people with mental abilities to reach these craft.
